title: PlayableRecordResult
description: Terminal user-visible result. video_url (final MP4) drives the player; the rest renders as metadata. Pure domain data — no UI fields.

title.description: Short human title of the recording.

description.description: One or two sentences: which playable, what the clip shows.

video_url.description: Final MP4 URL (*.mp4 — auto-rendered as video player).

has_audio.description: false when the audio tap failed and the video is silent (degraded).
